verdict.rationale: Application-form customization is a fair question for an ATS like Ashby, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack has nothing on custom application questions, knockout rules, or EEOC/demographic collection. The careers-page API and the generic 'design your perfect recruiting process' line are adjacent at best and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
